spans.s: (I)--A daughter of स्वायम्भुव Manu (Vai- राज-वा। प्।) and शतरूपा. Wife of Ruci. From her Hari manifested himself for imparting धर्म and ज्ञान। Gave birth to twins--a son and a daughter by पुत्रिकाधर्म। These were यज्ञ and दक्षिणा. भा.
(II)--the queen of Sarvatejas and mother of Manu चाक्षुष. भा. IV. १३. १५.
(VI)--became twins in the आकूति कल्प। वा. २१. ५५-56.
(VII)--a son of Brahman with a मन्त्रशरीर वा. ६
(VIII)--the mother of यज्ञ, the mindborn son in the first epoch of Manu. Vi.
(III)--the wife of पृथुसेन and mother of Nakta. भा. V. १५. 6.
